message.content: The company faces a risk that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion, which would be confirmed if the supply environment remains less flexible than a year ago and revenue conversion proves nonlinear over the next several quarters [D3]. A second risk is that one-time tariff impacts in fiscal 2026 will not repeat, creating a high comparison bar for future profitability that would be confirmed if operating margins fail to expand by more than 800 basis points compared with the previous year [D3]. A third risk involves the sustainability of $2 billion quarterly order levels, which would be confirmed if orders do not slightly increase from Q3 in line with seasonality or if the company fails to surpass $2 billion for a third consecutive quarter [D3].
